commands.name: browser-context
commands.summary: Use when you need a browser: open or close one for this agent. "fresh" starts an empty throwaway profile; "mine" opens a private Edge/Chrome copy of the person's profile without saved logins, whose snapshots and screenshots hide typed values. Both run in the background and leave the person's windows alone. A failed mine open grants no permission to control the computer, attach to the person's browser, sign in interactively, or switch identity or transport. Keep the contextId and close when done.

action.description: open starts a new browser and returns its contextId; close shuts it and deletes its folder.

browser.description: open only. fresh (default): empty legacy profile, outside copied-profile protection. mine: private copy of the person's profile with no saved-login stores, deleted on close. A failed mine open carries COPY_SOURCE_PERMISSION (the OS refused access; Desk cannot grant it) or COPY_SOURCE_POLICY (source qualification failed). The open reply's runtime names the Desk version and plugin root that ran.

context-id.description: close only. The contextId that open returned.

commands.name: browser-command
commands.summary: Use when you drive an owned browser context: run one command with `args`, a list of literal strings passed as arguments with no shell. Start with ["goto","https://example.com"] or ["snapshot"], then act on current refs; on AUTH_SNAPSHOT_INVALIDATED snapshot again. Every reply says where the tab is and whether the action navigated or changed the page. eval and run-code return what the script returns, unredacted. Open and close only through browser_context.

context-id.description: The contextId that browser_context open returned.

args.description: The command and its arguments, for example ["snapshot"] or ["fill","e4","text"]. In mine the commands are: snapshot [--interactive|--save], find <text>, goto <url>, go-back, go-forward, reload, wait [<seconds>|<text>|--gone <text>], click/dblclick/hover/check/uncheck <ref>, fill/type <ref> <text>, press [<ref>] <key>, select <ref> <value>, mousewheel <dx> <dy>, resize <w> <h>, screenshot [<ref>] [--full], tab-list, tab-new, tab-select <n>, tab-close [<n>], eval <function or expression> [<ref>], run-code <async function of page>, console [<level>], keydown/keyup <key>, mousemove <x> <y>, mousedown/mouseup [<button>], upload <ref> <file>..., dialog-accept [<text>], dialog-dismiss, localstorage-* and sessionstorage-* (list, get, set, delete, clear). Act on a ref soon after its snapshot. To type into a rich-text editor, fill its textbox ref, then press Enter; typed.verified says whether it holds the text. screenshot saves a PNG (real secrets blurred, nothing else hidden; do not crop the operator's own content out) in the evidence folder, which stays after close, and returns its path. A transient error page: ["reload"], then wait. Fresh keeps the legacy CLI commands, as JSON.
